items.headline: Samsara (NYSE:IOT) announced its 2026 Public Sector Customer Advisory Board to co-develop AI-driven connected operations solutions
Samsara (NYSE:IOT) launched the Samsara Driver Cup, a nationwide competition using real-world driving data to identify top professional drivers across safety, HOS compliance, and efficiency
Samsara (NYSE:IOT) released its 2026 State of Connected Operations Asset Theft & Loss Report, highlighting $13.2M in average annual losses for large operations without asset tracking
Samsara (NYSE:IOT) launched Smart Compliance, an integrated compliance platform for EU and UK fleets combining tachograph, AI safety, and infringement workflows
